prompt: Before our auth backend is ready I want to demo the @remcostoeten/auth-drawer login UI in our Vite React app. Use a fake/mock backend so I can click through sign-in, see the loading state, and trigger an error state. Show GitHub and Google buttons. Keep it minimal — one file is fine.

assertions.text: Wraps in <AuthProvider> and renders <AuthDrawer> with the mock adapter
Configures github and google providers (ui.auth.providers) or relies on the mock adapter's providers
Tells the user the mock credentials (admin@example.com / password) and/or how to trigger the error state
Does NOT import any non-public symbol (e.g. createAdapterError) or a non-existent subpath
